    attempts = 0

            break

        chunk_size = (len(current) + n - 1) // n
        chunks = [current[i*chunk_size:(i+1)*chunk_size] for i in range(n)]
        # remove any empty trailing chunks if len(current) not evenly divisible

                break
            candidate = current[:]
            # remove the i-th chunk
            start = sum(len(chunks[j]) for j in range(i))
            end = start + len(chunks[i])
            candidate = current[:start] + current[end:]
            attempts += 1
            # check if required failure items remain
            if required.issubset(set(candidate)):
                current = candidate
                n = max(n - 1, 2)  # slightly coarser
                removed = True
                break
        if not removed:
            n = min(2 * n, len(current))
    # one-minimal check: removing any single item should fail

    for i, item in enumerate(current):
        candidate = current[:i] + current[i+1:]
        if required.issubset(set(candidate)):
            one_minimal = False
            break
    return {
        'reduced_items': current,
        'attempts': attempts,
        'one_minimal': one_minimal
    }"
